question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person who supervises during an examination
solution:
The correct answer is 'Invigilator'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let us look into the meaning of the words in the options - 
 
 
• Invigilator - the person in the examination room responsible for conducting a particular examination session in the presence of the candidates.
 
• Examinee - a person taking an examination or test.
 
• Principal - the head of a school, college, or other educational institution.
 
• Administrator - a person responsible for carrying out the administration of a business or organization.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that invigilator is the best word to substitute the given group of words. 
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.
